ideas.title: Investigation into Alex Pretti Shooting
ideas.description: An investigation into the circumstances surrounding the fatal shooting of Alex Pretti by a Border Patrol agent in Minneapolis.
ideas.angle: Examining the Trump Administration's response to the incident and potential wrongdoing by the Border Patrol agent.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
Was the Border Patrol agent's actions justified?
ideas.insight: The investigation could reveal potential wrongdoing by the Border Patrol agent and the Trump Administration's handling of the incident.

ideas.title: Minnesota Welfare Fraud and Terrorist Funding
ideas.description: An investigation into the report linking Minnesota welfare fraud to terrorist funding.
ideas.angle: Examining the potential link between welfare fraud and terrorism in Minnesota.
questions: What is the extent of welfare fraud in Minnesota?
Is there a link between welfare fraud and terrorism?
ideas.insight: The investigation could reveal a larger issue with the state's welfare system and potential wrongdoing by individuals or organizations.
